coverage: Public operations are represented in named families; private helpers and state are grouped by behavior. Dispositions are review recommendations, not implemented changes.

entries.name: AccessMode, BackedOptions
entries.purpose: Select read/write, validation and scratch budget; reject unimplemented decoded cache
entries.costs: Options copied per session; nonzero decoded cache cannot be used

entries.name: DenseBuffer and DenseBuffer::from
entries.purpose: Describe caller numerical memory, shape, dtype and signed byte strides
entries.costs: Owned shape/stride vectors, validation and copies at transfer boundaries

entries.name: SparseBuffer
entries.purpose: Describe caller-owned sparse values, indices, offsets, dtypes and capacities
entries.costs: No allocation; capacity and width validation

entries.name: ReadRequirements
entries.purpose: Describe output shape, type and sparse NNZ before caller allocation
entries.costs: Owns shape vector; sparse one-shot path scans selection

entries.name: StorageOrganization, PhysicalArrayGeometry, StorageAxis, StorageGeometry
entries.purpose: Expose selected logical shape and native physical conflict geometry and capabilities
entries.costs: Several dynamic vectors, inspect and copy at acquisition

entries.name: TransferStats
entries.purpose: Expose transfer and selected scratch counters
entries.costs: Counters add per-transfer work; allocation semantics limited

entries.name: TransferContext ownership and lifecycle
entries.purpose: Move-only retained single-worker execution context
entries.costs: Heap allocation; backend fork and descriptor/resource preparation; shared session retained

entries.name: TransferContext::geometry, scratch_capacity, requirements
entries.purpose: Inspect geometry and sparse block requirements
entries.costs: Returns vector-rich descriptors by value; sparse requirements cached

entries.name: TransferContext::read_into, write_from
entries.purpose: Transfer dense/sparse blocks directly to/from caller memory
entries.costs: Validation, backend dispatch per rectangle, optional bounded staging

entries.name: MappedArray incl. data, byte_size, dtype, shape, unsafe_data, unsafe_dense
entries.purpose: Retain independent read-only mapped bytes with explicit typed opt-in
entries.costs: Shared owner and shape vector; typed interpretation is Linux/Clang contract

entries.name: PreparedRead incl. requirements, read and read_into
entries.purpose: Retain requirements for one-shot allocation or caller-buffer read
entries.costs: Shared implementation allocation; descriptor reinspection; sparse scan

entries.name: BackedArray metadata getters
entries.purpose: Get layout, dtypes, rank, extent and shape
entries.costs: Each describes and inspects backend; shape allocated

entries.name: BackedArray::select
entries.purpose: Compose selected logical axes into retained handle
entries.costs: Metadata inspections and shared node allocation; gathers retain positions

entries.name: BackedArray::read, prepare_read, read_into
entries.purpose: Materialize or read selected numerical array to caller buffer
entries.costs: One-shot descriptor inspection; sparse may rescan; owning read allocates

entries.name: BackedArray::storage_geometry, prepare_transfer
entries.purpose: Describe physical access and retain per-worker resources
entries.costs: Metadata repeated; backend reopened/forked and tile allocated

entries.name: BackedArray::map_readonly
entries.purpose: Request direct read-only mapping for eligible full arrays
entries.costs: Explicit no-fallback failure; retained mapping and platform constraints

entries.name: BackedArray::write
entries.purpose: Direct update matching numerical structure
entries.costs: Validation, scatter/packing; noncontiguous sparse source copy

entries.name: BackedStringArray incl. shape,size,string,select,read
entries.purpose: Retained lazily selected string storage descriptor
entries.costs: Node sharing, backend metadata and string allocation; no typed mmap

entries.name: BackedColumn incl. size,kind,nullable,ordered,values
entries.purpose: Expose typed lazy column and values
entries.costs: Metadata inspections and owned handles

entries.name: BackedColumn::codes,categories,unsafe_codes,unsafe_categories
entries.purpose: Expose logical categorical or explicitly unsafe physical encodings
entries.costs: Potential pruning plan, shared spill page and scans

entries.name: BackedColumn::select, read
entries.purpose: Select rows and materialize a column
entries.costs: Selection metadata and allocations; category pruning

entries.name: BackedTable incl. size,index_name,name,names,column_names,contains,column,select,read
entries.purpose: Expose lazy dataframe and selected indexed columns
entries.costs: Metadata, names/column strings, possible disk scans and allocations

entries.name: BackedElement incl. kind,keys,contains,at,array,string_array,column,table,field_names,read_field,read
entries.purpose: Navigate nested lazy variants and materialize values/record fields
entries.costs: Runtime metadata checks and handle creation at access boundaries

entries.name: BackedAnnDataView slot and key accessors
entries.purpose: Read-only retained AnnData axis and slot navigation including raw
entries.costs: Inspection and handle allocation; view shares session

entries.name: BackedAnnDataView::slice,read,to_memory
entries.purpose: Compose aligned selection or materialize independent AnnData
entries.costs: Per-slice history and selector storage; read visits all selected data

entries.name: StructureEdit incl. set,erase,set_obs,set_var,reindex,apply
entries.purpose: Stage validated structural changes and reindex aligned data
entries.costs: Heap state and backend rewrites; invalidates handles; not whole-store transaction

entries.name: BackedAnnData owner lifecycle,open,writable,location,view
entries.purpose: Own session while retaining read-only child views
entries.costs: View allocation and shared lifetime; caller serializes lifecycle

entries.name: BackedAnnData axis and slot accessor/name forwarding
entries.purpose: Expose writable owner handles and all aligned slots
entries.costs: View allocation and repeated metadata discovery

entries.name: BackedAnnData::read,to_memory,validate_all,flush,close
entries.purpose: Materialize, validate or explicitly control store lifetime
entries.costs: Full data read for materialization/validation; close invalidates

entries.name: BackedAnnData::edit_structure,set,erase
entries.purpose: Provide staged and convenience structural operations
entries.costs: Backend I/O and validation; structural invalidation

entries.name: BackedAnnData internal constructor and detail storage bridges
entries.purpose: Bridge module-visible facade to private backend implementations
entries.costs: Exported implementation surface and dependencies

entries.name: Attribute, Attributes, RecordFieldInfo, NodeInfo
entries.purpose: Represent backend-native metadata and physical schema
entries.costs: Tree maps, variants, strings and vectors copied during inspection

entries.name: NumericTransferStats, NumericWriteAxis, NumericWrite
entries.purpose: Communicate transfer metrics and selected-write axes/packing callback
entries.costs: Vectors and erased callback at backend transfer boundary

entries.name: NumericTransfer virtual interface
entries.purpose: Retain pre-inspected numeric backend object for one worker
entries.costs: Virtual dispatch per rectangle, backend ownership and lifetime dependency

entries.name: Backend virtual interface
entries.purpose: Private extension boundary for schema, numeric/string/record I/O, mutation, map and lifecycle
entries.costs: Virtual calls per operation; native backend resources; scratch workspace accounting

entries.name: Backend::read_strings_bounded default
entries.purpose: Conservative bounded adapter fallback
entries.costs: Often one string per call; backend may allocate before checking budget

entries.name: Backend record and mapping optional methods
entries.purpose: Signal backend capability with explicit unsupported errors
entries.costs: Virtual boundary; some default unsupported/no-op methods

entries.name: backed shared helper declarations
entries.purpose: Connect serialization, category plans, validation, copying and model navigation
entries.costs: Private partition size and rebuild coupling; helper code lives in owners

entries.name: backed_detail::Axis
entries.purpose: Represent affine, gathered or category-mapped physical selection
entries.costs: Shared owners; per-coordinate representation branch; category plan paging

entries.name: SliceStage, ColorPromotion, ColorOverride
entries.purpose: Retain axis history and promote category colors during slices
entries.costs: History and plan sharing; potentially data-dependent metadata

entries.name: Revision and Session
entries.purpose: Retain backend, options, lifecycle and path invalidation state
entries.costs: Shared mutable map and counters require serialized mutation/access

entries.name: BackedNode
entries.purpose: Retain path, axes, revision snapshot and transform state
entries.costs: Shared_ptr reference counts, strings/vectors, per-handle allocation

entries.name: BackedAccess
entries.purpose: Private friend bridge into backed handles
entries.costs: Small accessors; private module coupling

entries.name: BackedDataset
entries.purpose: Retain session, axis selections, revision and slice history
entries.costs: Shared ownership and copies on view creation

entries.name: fail,index_path,require_dataset,present
entries.purpose: Diagnose invalid objects and resolve index/presence
entries.costs: Backend inspections and string errors

entries.name: aligned_axes,mapping_names
entries.purpose: Validate aligned shapes and list backend mapping children
entries.costs: Multiple inspections; returned vectors/strings

entries.name: child,string_attr,strings_attr,encoding
entries.purpose: Validate names and decode supported encoding/version attributes
entries.costs: String copies and variant/map lookup per metadata inspection

entries.name: Session::check_open,check_writable,invalidate,check_node
entries.purpose: Enforce lifecycle, writable capability and revisions
entries.costs: Per-operation checks; invalidation scans revision map

entries.name: logical_shape
entries.purpose: Interpret stored physical or AnnData logical shape
entries.costs: Backend inspection and vector construction; some encodings have no shape

entries.name: node
entries.purpose: Build retained axis-aware validated handle
entries.costs: Several metadata inspections, map insertion and allocations

entries.name: select_axis
entries.purpose: Compose affine, indexed, masked or label selection
entries.costs: Gather allocation; label selection scans backend and retains matching positions

entries.name: make_store
entries.purpose: Check root, options and create retained session/dataset
entries.costs: Metadata inspection and owner allocations

entries.name: check_dataset_children,root_view
entries.purpose: Reject unknown children on materialization and construct root view
entries.costs: Metadata traversal and set allocation

entries.name: BackedAnnDataView accessors, slice, read
entries.purpose: Traverse and materialize selected AnnData
entries.costs: Per-slot inspection, handles, selection history; full payload materialization

entries.name: BackedAnnData owner methods
entries.purpose: Forward API and control underlying session
entries.costs: Extra allocated view copies on simple forwarding

entries.name: BackedArray::storage_geometry implementation
entries.purpose: Derive physical descriptors and parallel capability from backend schema
entries.costs: Repeated metadata inspection and descriptor copies

entries.name: size arithmetic and dtype allocation helpers
entries.purpose: Guard overflow and allocate dtype-specific memory
entries.costs: Runtime dtype switch per owning allocation

entries.name: Descriptor and describe
entries.purpose: Collect and validate dense/sparse schema, selection and physical metadata
entries.costs: Inspections, sparse child enumeration/sort, vectors; repeated for getters

entries.name: stride and DenseBuffer validation
entries.purpose: Validate signed extents, byte spans, shape and dtype
entries.costs: Per-rank arithmetic and shape/stride vector allocations

entries.name: forward_rectangle,staging_budget,dense_block_shape
entries.purpose: Choose bounded geometry-aware rectangular staging
entries.costs: Per-rank vector and arithmetic; explicit workspace budget

entries.name: ReadPoint, ReadAxis, disjoint_dense
entries.purpose: Group selection indices and reject alias-unsafe scatter
entries.costs: Per-axis sorting/lookup and vectors; conservative fallback

entries.name: grouped_shard_read
entries.purpose: Batch gathered sharded reads by codec tile
entries.costs: O(sum selected axis lengths) metadata allocation; tile staging; scatters

entries.name: dense_transfer
entries.purpose: Implement one-shot direct or bounded packed numerical transfer
entries.costs: Backend dispatch per rectangle/run, scans, stride calculations, temporary tile

entries.name: read_index,write_index,pack_index,unpack_index
entries.purpose: Convert/check sparse integer widths and reject invalid values
entries.costs: Runtime dtype switch may recur per sparse value

entries.name: MinorLookup
entries.purpose: Map physical sparse minor indices to selected positions
entries.costs: Optional hash allocation or repeated linear selector scan

entries.name: scan_sparse,requirements,sparse_into
entries.purpose: Count and fill selected sparse result with checked widths
entries.costs: Major-axis reads and per-index dispatch; possible two full scans

entries.name: write_sparse
entries.purpose: Validate sparse topology then update selected values
entries.costs: Two structure scans and I/O; preserves duplicate write ordering

entries.name: copy_dense,copy_sparse
entries.purpose: Stream dense/sparse source to backend within scratch budget
entries.costs: Tile allocation, backend calls; sparse requirements plus transfer scans

entries.name: PreparedReadImpl,read_prepared,read_array,copy_array
entries.purpose: Own requirements and materialize or export selected arrays
entries.costs: Heap state; descriptor reinspection; dense/sparse allocation

entries.name: PreparedRead and BackedArray getters/select/read implementations
entries.purpose: Expose one-shot backed access, retained selects and mapping
entries.costs: Repeated metadata and shared-node/impl allocations

entries.name: selected_write,packing_metadata,pack_view,view_packer
entries.purpose: Construct bounded gathered-source write packing and type dispatch
entries.costs: Temporary axis vectors per pack; dispatch once at acquisition

entries.name: write_gathered_view
entries.purpose: Write irregular dense source using bounded pack or shard selection
entries.costs: Forked backend, temporary buffers and per-axis coordinate metadata

entries.name: BackedArray::write implementation
entries.purpose: Write selected dense or structure-compatible sparse source
entries.costs: Noncontiguous sparse source materialized; full validation by option

entries.name: TransferContextImpl
entries.purpose: Own worker descriptor, backend, transfer handles, tile and cached sparse requirement
entries.costs: Worker backend fork and staging, shared session read-only checks

entries.name: TransferContextImpl::block,requirements
entries.purpose: Validate block and cache native sparse endpoints
entries.costs: Runtime dtype checks; backend offset reads; per-block vectors

entries.name: TransferContextImpl::dense
entries.purpose: Direct rectangular transfer or bounded irregular fallback
entries.costs: Validation, dtype normalization, per-run backend dispatch; temporary vectors

entries.name: TransferContext::read_into sparse
entries.purpose: Read native major block preserving index/offset widths
entries.costs: Scans offsets and validates indices; caller-owned output

entries.name: TransferContext::stats
entries.purpose: Aggregate backend and tile telemetry
entries.costs: Current tile counted by presence; not cumulative allocation counter

entries.name: BackedArray::prepare_transfer implementation
entries.purpose: Capture schema and fork private worker resources
entries.costs: Multiple inspections, fork, prepared resource objects and staging

entries.name: StreamMode, StreamOperation, StreamPhase, StreamLimit
entries.purpose: Expose execution and adaptation policy/reasons
entries.costs: Public interface width and compatibility

entries.name: StreamOptions
entries.purpose: Bound block sizing, workers, scratch and adaptation
entries.costs: Per-worker capacities are advisory planning inputs, not actual reservations

entries.name: BlockRequest, BlockCompletion
entries.purpose: Exchange coverage/conflict geometry and measurement sample
entries.costs: Owned vectors copied per request; caller owns timing and buffers

entries.name: StreamSettings, StreamStats
entries.purpose: Report planned capacity, mode and observations
entries.costs: Counters and value-return copies; no proof of physical memory allocation

entries.name: BlockStream lifecycle,next,complete,split,configure,settings,stats,finished
entries.purpose: Issue disjoint physical work with caller-owned scheduling and bounded adaptation
entries.costs: Heap state, per-block vector copies, lane lookup, bounded timing sort

entries.name: fail,mul,product,width,ceil_div,validate
entries.purpose: Enforce geometry/capacity policy and sizing
entries.costs: Per-rank checks and dtype switch at stream creation

entries.name: Lane and BlockStreamImpl state
entries.purpose: Retain conflict regions, worker requests and adaptive epochs
entries.costs: Several vectors per lane and bounded timing sample storage

entries.name: BlockStreamImpl constructor
entries.purpose: Validate snapshot/capacities and choose physical grid
entries.costs: O(rank + worker count) metadata; caller allocation remains separate

entries.name: reset_epoch,live,flush_window,reset_exploration
entries.purpose: Track bounded interval union and adaptive state
entries.costs: Sorts bounded samples, scans lanes

entries.name: advance_grid,region,advance,find
entries.purpose: Plan logical coverage and exclusive conflict regions
entries.costs: Per-rank work, vector manipulation and lane scan per completion

entries.name: candidate,tune,finish
entries.purpose: Explore block/flight counts only with measured overlap evidence
entries.costs: Control state machine, bounded sorting and trial work

entries.name: next,complete,split,configure,settings,stats,finished implementations
entries.purpose: Issue and complete caller-executed work and guard configuration
entries.costs: Request copies and scans; no explicit failed-request state
